visual_action: A slideshow of stock photos showing various people eating healthy foods like salads. In the middle of the montage, a photo of Donald Trump eating KFC from a bucket on a private jet is briefly shown before returning to more photos of people eating healthily.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: A photo of him eating KFC is central to the video's premise, and the on-screen text says 'hiding trump'.

on_screen_text.text: hiding trump in healthy people to see if anyone notices (level impossible)

spoken_summary: The audio consists of lyrics from a pop song: "She gives me love and affection. Baby, did I mention you're the only girl for me..."
audio_music: The video is set to the upbeat, popular pop song 'Cheerleader' by OMI, which plays throughout. The cheerful, summery music creates an ironic or lighthearted contrast to the political mockery.
editing_pacing: The video is a simple slideshow of static images with quick cuts between them.
cultural_references: The video uses a common meme format of 'hiding X in Y to see if anyone notices'.
central_claim: The post visually jokes that Donald Trump's lifestyle, represented by his preference for fast food, is the antithesis of a healthy one.
intended_effect: To encourage viewers to find the contrast humorous and mock Donald Trump for his perceived unhealthy eating habits.
